name: RxTerms
tagline: NLM Clinical Tables autocomplete for prescription drug names and related RxTerms data.
description: RxTerms is part of the National Library of Medicine Clinical Tables API. It provides free, no-auth autocomplete and lookup for prescription drug names, strengths, and related RxTerms fields used in clinical and medication UIs. Developers typically call it for typeahead drug name suggestions and structured medication display strings.

auth.details: No authentication required; public NLM Clinical Tables endpoints are open without API keys or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free of charge for anyone; contact NLM if expected usage exceeds 50,000 calls/day.

rate_limits: Advised maximum 25 requests/second (soft; the enforced limit may be higher depending on system load). Handle X-RateLimit-Limit, Retry-After, and HTTP 503; notify NLM if regularly exceeding 50 requests/second.

example.response_snippet: [5, ["Lipitor (Oral Pill)", "atorvastatin (Oral Pill)"], null, [["Lipitor (Oral Pill)"], ["atorvastatin (Oral Pill)"]], {"STRENGTHS_AND_FORMS":[["10 mg Tab","20 mg Tab"],["10 mg Tab","20 mg Tab","40 mg Tab"]],"RXCUIS":[["261549","261550"],["83367","83368","83369"]]}]

use_cases: autocomplete prescription drug names as a user types
look up strengths and dosage forms for a selected drug name
map drug display names to RxCUI identifiers for medication records
populate medication pickers in clinical or pharmacy workflows
